decision_criteria: If the limitation is explicitly disclosed in the launch materials and certification with caveats is permitted under policy, the case could move toward compliant_with_caveats.

If there is approved risk acceptance or a finalized approved mitigation meeting the stated policy elements, the case could move toward compliant or compliant_with_caveats depending on the final disclosure posture.
If launch proceeds while the model card still says there are no known material limitations and no approved exception exists, the case becomes noncompliant.
Absent evidence resolving the disclosure/approval gap, preserve concern that the packet overstates support for certification.
evidence_requests: Provide the finalized model card or launch disclosure showing the health-plan benefits support limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide any approved risk acceptance covering the unresolved launch-use-case weakness.
Provide a finalized mitigation/runbook with named owner, concrete threshold, review date, rollback criterion, and customer notice criterion.
